name: gmail
title: Gmail
description: A Gmail mailbox reached over IMAP and SMTP — signed in with Google, or with an address and an app password.
needed_for: Reads your Gmail inbox into conversations.
justification: A Gmail data source reads the mailbox over IMAP and sends over SMTP as you. Google accepts either a Google sign-in that grants mail access or an app password for that, never the account password.

GMAIL_GOOGLE.label: Sign in with Google
GMAIL_GOOGLE.hint: Uses the Google account you pick — nothing to type.

GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD.label: App password
GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD.hint: Needs 2-Step Verification on. If your Workspace admin turned app passwords off, sign in with Google instead.

app_password.label: App password
app_password.hint: Type your Gmail address and a 16-letter app password.
